Instruments.Instrument.Instrument Class¶

class Instruments.Instrument.Instrument(instrument, name, save_files_path=None)[source]¶

Bases: object

Generic Instrument class meant to contain required functionality of all IEEE 488.2 instruments

Query and clear the event register for the standard event status register.

save_data(data, file_name='data', format=EFileType.CSV)[source]¶

Save data to a file in the specified save path.

Parameters:

  • data (dict) – The data to be saved.

  • filename (str) – The name of the file to save the data in.

  • format (EFileType) – The format in which to save the data. Default is EFileType.CSV.

set_enable_event_status(value)[source]¶

Set the enable register for the standard event status register set.

Parameters:

value (int) – An integer value where bit 1 and bit 6 are not used (always 0). The range corresponds to binary numbers X0XXXX0X.

set_enable_service_request(value)[source]¶

Set the enable register for the status byte register set.

Parameters:

value (int) – An integer value from 0 to 255. Bit 0 and bit 1 of the status byte register are not used and are always treated as 0.

set_operation_complete()[source]¶

Set the Operation Complete bit (bit 0) in the standard event status register to 1 after the current operation is finished.

set_status_operation_enable(value: int)[source]¶

Sets the enable mask for the OPERation register. :param value: The integer value of the enable mask (range: 0 through 65535). :type value: int

wait_for_operation_finish()[source]¶

Wait for the current operation to finish. The subsequent command can only be carried out after the current command has been executed.
